about.intro: Premium anti-tarnish, gold-alike jewellery and everyday beauty from Mumbai — pocket friendly and shipped across India.

announcements.text: Anti-tarnish gold-alike jewellery · Ships across India · 97698 36346

policies.shipping: We ship across India with tracked courier — 2–6 working days depending on the pin code, and usually next day within Mumbai. Shipping is confirmed on WhatsApp before dispatch.
policies.returns: Unworn pieces can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery, in their box with the tag intact. If something arrives damaged, send a photograph the same day and we will replace it.

products.name: Noor Layered Chain Set
products.description: Three fine chains, graduated in length and finished with a single crystal pendant. Worn together they read as one deliberate piece; worn alone, each holds its own. The clasp is adjustable, so the longest chain can sit at the collarbone or below it.
products.fabric: Gold-plated brass, anti-tarnish coating, cubic zirconia pendant, adjustable clasp
products.care: Nickel-free and anti-tarnish. Wipe with a dry cloth after wear and keep away from perfume and chlorine.

products.name: Meher Jhumka
products.description: A classic dome jhumka with a pearl drop, finished by hand so the second earring matches the first. Light enough for a full working day, and loud enough to carry an outfit on its own.
products.fabric: Gold-plated alloy, anti-tarnish coating, faux pearl drop, nickel-free posts
products.care: Nickel-free and suitable for sensitive ears. Wipe after wear; do not soak.

products.name: Zoya Stacking Rings
products.description: A set of fine rings meant to be worn together in any order — one plain, one stone-set, one twisted. Buy the set of three for a first stack, or five for a full hand.
products.fabric: Gold-plated brass, anti-tarnish coating, cubic zirconia accents
products.care: Nickel-free and water-resistant. Remove before swimming or applying lotion.

products.name: Velvet Matte Lipstick
products.description: A soft matte that does not chalk out by lunch — buildable colour, comfortable on the lip, and chosen to sit beside gold jewellery rather than fight it. Three everyday shades.
products.fabric: Cream matte base, vitamin E, rose-nude / brick / mauve pigments
products.care: Dermatologically tested and cruelty-free. Check the shade name on the base before gifting.

products.name: Gulbahar Choker Set
products.description: A stone-set choker with a matching pair of jhumkas — the wedding-guest answer when there is no time to shop for a set. The choker sits flat against the neck and the earrings are weighted light enough to keep on through the photographs.
products.fabric: Gold-plated alloy, anti-tarnish coating, ruby-red and clear stones, pearl drops
products.care: Nickel-free. Store in the pouch provided; avoid direct perfume spray on the stones.

products.name: Sana Pearl Studs
products.description: The pair that never leaves the ear. A single pearl on a low-profile setting, small enough to sleep in and clean enough for a workday. Choose gold or rose-gold tone.
products.fabric: Gold-plated brass, anti-tarnish coating, shell pearl, nickel-free posts
products.care: Nickel-free. Keep away from hairspray and perfume; wipe with a soft dry cloth.

products.name: Afshan Signature Bangle
products.description: A single polished bangle with a fine engraved edge — the piece customers come back for in a second size. Wear one alone or stack three; the finish is tested to keep its colour through daily wear.
products.fabric: Gold-plated alloy, anti-tarnish coating, hand-finished engraving
products.care: Nickel-free. Wipe after wear and store flat to protect the shape.

products.name: Oud & Rose Eau de Parfum
products.description: Rose at the top, oud underneath, and enough warmth to last an evening without being loud in a small room. The bottle is boxed and ready to give as it is.
products.fabric: Rose, oud, amber and musk in an alcohol-free-look base; 30 ml and 50 ml
products.care: For external use only. Keep away from direct sunlight; patch test before first use.
